structuredContent.latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the investigator stage. The draft conditionally retains windowing, requires stable record and field keys, keeps edits outside recycled row widgets, and rejects automatically moving focus to the next row when a record disappears. It treats accessibility counts and indexes as necessary metadata, not proof that offscreen rows work with a particular platform or screen reader. [WAI-ARIA 1.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/2023/REC-wai-aria-1.2-20230606/), [AG Grid accessibility guidance](https://www.ag-grid.com/javascript-data-grid/accessibility/), [Windows UI Automation virtualized-item pattern](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/winauto/uiauto-implementingvirtualizeditem)
